{{Quote|A freighter of mine has disappeared. It's presumed destroyed or captured by pirates.|[[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]], on the ''First Light''|<ref name="Outward Bound (Living Force adventure)">{{LivingForce|Looking In: Outward Bound}}</ref>}}
The '''''First Light''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was used by the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]-based company [[Renna's Transport Service]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''First Light'' was dispatched from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] to deliver a cargo of [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]] [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to [[House D'Vails]], a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] house that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. However, the crew of the freighter were secretly in league with the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a powerful band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and once the ''First Light'' had left the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]], the crew sent out a distress signal and jettisoned some scrap metal from the ship, then jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and joined up with the Brotherhood. The ship's disappearance was subsequently investigated by the [[Thaereian military]], who discovered the debris that the crew of the ''First Light'' had left, and erroneously came to the conclusion that the vessel had been destroyed.

A short time later, the ''First Light'' traveled to Druckenwell and a group of Brotherhood pirates led by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] [[Denma]] and [[Tazzik]] departed from the planet in the freighter, intent on flying it to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[New Dawn (space station)|''New Dawn'']], to carry out a terrorist attack. However, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] stowed away aboard the ''First Light'' and confronted the pirates, preventing them from succeeding with their raid.
